description: We are a team of five Computer Science students from UET Lahore and Arid Agriculture University Rawalpindi: Subhan, Zakaullah, Muhammad Abrar, Maaz Ur Rehman and Ahsan Ali. Our interests include AI/ML, software development, data analysis, and space exploration. We aim to build AeroFlame Intelligence, an evidence-based platform exploring NASA's microgravity combustion data. We welcome collaboration in Python, AI, web development, data visualization, design, and space science.
